purpose: Prevent a full-resolution RCP import when SCAN cannot verify available space on its configured data volume.

implementation.behavior: An OSError from disk_usage(DATA_DIR) returns HTTP 503 with storage_check=unavailable before cloud or job rows are created.
implementation.openapi: Both single-node and multi-node RCP import routes document HTTP 503; HTTP 507 remains documented for a measured insufficient-space result.

verification.mode: Direct isolated FastAPI TestClient invocation of the same pytest functions; pytest temp directory cleanup is denied by the managed Windows environment.
passed_checks: OpenAPI documents 503 and 507 on both RCP import routes.
Two-node RCP imports as separate clouds when preflight has sufficient space.
Measured low space rejects a multi-node RCP before cloud/job creation (507).
Measured low space rejects a single-node RCP before cloud/job creation (507).
Inaccessible storage rejects a multi-node RCP before cloud/job creation (503).
If all RCP node point counts are missing/zero, inaccessible storage still returns 503 before cloud/job creation.
verification.database: isolated temporary S2B_DATA_DIR; removed after check
verification.source_files: synthetic RCS/RCP fixtures only; FARO originals not opened or modified

acceptance.remaining: A readable destination with enough capacity and full-resolution FARO RCP/ReCap acceptance are still required; manifests without usable counts continue to rely on the live per-chunk reserve check after the accessible-volume preflight.
